ns2:section.sectionText: Professional Skills in Information Science-In this course, students will learn about and develop professional skills in the information sciences, a broad and interdisciplinary field at the intersection of people, information, and technology. Students will engage in professional skill building for a broad range of employment in the information professions with a specific focus on internship and career readiness. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
